posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You can see the last commands are going through several functions in VisuStella plugins.
The Core Engine has a number of plugin parameters and notetags dedicated to calculating parameters, and I would assume that will cause conflicts with
any
other plugin trying to manipulate them.
Since VisuStella obfuscates their code, other programmers can't just make their work compatible. So I suspect you will have to choose whether you make your parameters work the way you want through the features of the Core Engine, or find alternatives for the features from VS plugins.
